g1.label: 1. More than living inside a ___
g1.why: The text says Scottish identity is about more than living inside a border on a map.

g2.label: 2. As well as English and Gaelic, Scots speak ___
g2.why: The text says many Scots also speak the Scots language.

g3.label: 3. A "bairn" is a ___
g3.why: The text defines a "bairn" as a child.

g4.label: 4. To be "wabbit" means to be ___
g4.why: The text defines "wabbit" as meaning tired.

g5.label: 5. Scots was wrongly seen as "bad ___"
g5.why: The text says Scots was once wrongly seen as "bad English".

g6.label: 6. Part of the UK since ___
g6.why: The text says Scotland has been part of the UK since 1707.

g7.label: 7. Scotland kept its own legal, church and ___ system
g7.why: The text says Scotland kept its own legal, church and education systems.

g8.label: 8. In 2014, Scots voted on ___
g8.why: The text says Scots voted in a 2014 referendum on independence.

g1.label: 1. ___ Scotland is part of the UK...
g1.why: ‘Although’ introduces a contrast at the start of the sentence.

g2.label: 2. English ___ Gaelic and Scots
g2.why: ‘As well as’ adds further items to a list.

g4.label: 4. Seen as "bad English". ___, it is now recognised
g4.why: ‘However’ shows a contrast with the previous sentence.

g5.label: 5. Voted to stay, ___ many still feel strongly
g5.why: ‘But’ shows a contrast between the two clauses.

g6.label: 6. Kept its own church, ___ identity stayed strong
g6.why: ‘So’ shows the result of the previous clause.

g7.label: 7. Identity matters ___ it connects them to history

g8.label: 8. ___, most Scots see their identity as proud

g1.label: 1. (contrast) Edinburgh is old; ___...
g1.why: ‘However’ signals a contrast between the two clauses.

g2.label: 2. (reason) Proud ___ their history is rich
g2.why: ‘Because’ introduces the reason for the pride.

g3.label: 3. (result) It rained all day, ___ we stayed inside
g3.why: ‘So’ introduces the result of the rain.

g4.label: 4. (addition) Its own words ___ its own grammar
g4.why: ‘As well as’ adds a further point.

g6.label: 6. (contrast) ___ the cold weather...
g6.why: ‘Despite’ + noun introduces a contrast at the start of the sentence.

g7.label: 7. (result) The debate was close; ___...
g7.why: ‘Therefore’ introduces the result of the close debate.

g8.label: 8. (concession) ___ Scots is different...
g8.why: ‘Although’ introduces a concession — a point conceded despite the main claim.
